name: Revolution Medicines, Inc.
summary: Revolution Medicines, Inc., a clinical-stage precision oncology company, develops novel targeted therapies for RAS-addicted cancers. The company's research and development pipeline consist of RAS(ON) inhibitors that binds RAS variants to be used as monotherapy in combination with other RAS(ON) inhibitors and/or in combination with RAS companion inhibitors or other therapeutic agents, and RAS companion inhibitors to suppress cooperating targets and pathways that sustain RAS-addicted cancers.
